definitions.explanation: A member of the military or armed forces.

examples.japanese: {軍人|ぐんじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{軍人|ぐんじん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My father is a former military member.

examples.japanese: {軍人|ぐんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
{軍人|ぐんじん} combines ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (military) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {軍人|ぐんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (become a soldier)
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{軍人|ぐんじん} (former military personnel)
- ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧{軍人|ぐんじん} (career soldier)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自衛官|じえいかん}→自衛官：27993_jieikan⟧: Self-Defense Force member (modern Japan)
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier, enlisted personnel
- ⟦{将校|しょうこう}→将校：27992_shoukou⟧: military officer

Note: In modern Japan, ⟦{自衛官|じえいかん}→自衛官：27993_jieikan⟧ is used for SDF members. {軍人|ぐんじん} may refer to soldiers of other countries or historical contexts.
